title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - DaySchedule
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/DaySchedule. Scheduled actions to be executed at a given time for a day profile.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DaySchedule'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasStartTime.description: Property. [COSEM] Time when the script is going to be executed.

executesScript.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Defines the script to be executed.
